entities.summary: Emilio Esteban-Infantes Martín was a Spanish officer who served during the Spanish Civil War, and later in World War II as commander of the Blue Division, or the 250th Infantry Division of the German Wehrmacht. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross of Nazi Germany.
